jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

What will you do?

• Clean the interiors of tankers, bulk trucks, container trucks and other vehicles.
• Operate a forklift to move materials and goods.
• Ensure that cleaning orders are carried out correctly.
• Carefully monitor the work during cleaning activities.
• Refill cleaning products in a timely manner.
• Perform general cleaning and maintenance of the workplace.
• Comply with applicable safety and quality regulations.
• Work together with colleagues to complete cleaning assignments efficiently.

Who are you?

• You are characterised by motivation, a willingness to learn and a hands-on mentality.
• Speaking Dutch, English or German is not a problem for you.
• Good physical fitness is important, as this is a physically demanding job; candidates must not suffer from back problems.
• You are comfortable working at heights or in smaller, enclosed spaces.
• Working safely and using the necessary personal protective equipment is second nature to you.
• Experience operating a forklift is required; a forklift certificate is an advantage, but not essential.
• You do not wear glasses, or you are willing to wear contact lenses.
• Basic knowledge of computer programs is an advantage.
• You are able to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility are among your strengths.
• Your own means of transport is essential, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.
• Experience in industrial cleaning or the cleaning sector is an advantage, but motivation is the priority.

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and French

As an Administrative & Operations Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of daily operational activities across payments, cash management, trade finance, and client administration.

Client Details

Join a well-established international financial institution with a strong presence across EMEA. Known for its expertise in corporate banking, financial services, and global markets, the company offers a collaborative environment where innovation, operational excellence, and long-term client relationships are at the heart of its success.

Description

• Process and monitor domestic and international payments.
• Manage incoming client requests and internal inquiries via email and phone.
• Support administrative follow-up of banking operations and client files.
• Assist with Trade Finance and Guarantee-related transactions.
• Maintain and update client documentation and e-banking agreements.
• Perform reconciliations, operational controls, and account maintenance tasks.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and KYC requirements.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects.
• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset (french big plus)
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.
• Strong communication skills and a client-focused mindset.
• Previous experience in administration, operations, banking support, or financial services is a plus.

Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you technically inclined and eager to work in a dynamic production environment where you can continuously develop yourself? Then this position as an assembly worker in a 2-shift system might be something for you!

Your role

As an assembly worker, you play an important role in the production process of seating solutions, such as chairs for, among others, De Lijn. You will start with an intensive training program where you will get familiar with various assembly techniques. This way, you build the knowledge and skills to grow into a true specialist.

Responsibilities

Assembling parts for car seats according to technical instructions

Covering cushions with fabric or leather

Performing visual quality checks on finished products

Identifying and reporting errors or deviations
- Vaardigheden:

You have technical insight, from your school background, previous work experiences, or from a technical hobby. 

You can handle the heat well, as you'll be working in a warm environment.

You're eager to learn and ready to get your hands dirty.

- Attesten:

/

- Opleidingsvereisten:

A technical education is a plus, but not required.

- Vakkennis:

You have some initial experience in assembly.

- Talenkennis:

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or a good knowledge of English. Either one is enough!

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

For a leading company active in the housing and real estate sector, we are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.
Your responsibilities
As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization
• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes
• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions
• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings
• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines
• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment
In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential
• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems
• Fluent communication skills in English
• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues
• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus
You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

jobs.occupation: Road Logistics Full & Part Loads Teamleader International
jobs.description:
Company Overview
Kuehne+Nagel is a leading global logistics provider, known for its innovative supply chain solutions and strong customer focus. For our Road Logistics division in Belgium, we are looking for a proactive and experienced Team Leader Dispatching to oversee and coordinate the daily activities of our dispatch team. This role involves managing operations for both full truckloads (FTL) and part loads (LTL), while supporting our dedicated groupage department and cross-dock activities, which form a crucial part of our transport network.
 

Position Summary
As a Team Leader, you oversee and guide a team of Dispatchers who specialize in chartering LTL and FTL shipments within our Road Logistics department in Kampenhout. You are responsible for coordinating and monitoring daily transport activities, ensuring that all shipments are dispatched efficiently, cost effectively, and in full compliance with Belgian transport regulations. Leveraging your operational expertise and strong communication skills, you support your team in working effectively with planners, drivers, subcontractors, and customer service teams. Together, you ensure smooth execution of all transport movements, selecting the most suitable subcontractors based on quality, performance, and price, while fostering continuous operational improvement within the team.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• You are the direct manager of a team of 8 to 12 transport planners. This includes target setting and follow-up, yearly evaluations and disciplinary actions if applicable. You make sure that work is divided evenly within the team and look for the “right person“on the “right job“.  

• You are the first point of contact for escalations within your team. You act as a coach and a knowledge expert and provide support to your employees in case of questions. 

• You supervise the daily operational scheduling and actively identify new opportunities within your team to improve services or reduce costs. 

• You Identify Trends through preset KPI’s and act where needed. 

• You are responsible for optimizing operational and administrative processes for more efficiency and actively propose improvement projects.   

 
 

 

Qualifications
 
 

•  Bachelor’s degree in supply chain or equivalent by experience  

•  Proven experience in Logistics, preferably road freight & planning 

• Experience in managing a team 

•  Hand on Mentality & flexible mindset.  

•  IT Savvy, ability to work in different IT systems and programs.  

•  Knowledge of Dutch, English and French. Any other language is an asset.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

Commercial & Supplier Management

Stakeholder Management

Your role

ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures.

risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures.

QHES and ADN documentation.

inland tanker shipping is highly valued.
